name: secure_otp_customer_verification
description: Verify the customer through a secure OTP page backed by Webex Connect Generate OTP and Verify OTP nodes before returning a CRM portal URL or allowing access to protected customer data.

input_entities.customer_id: The bank customer identifier from the contact flow or CRM lookup.
input_entities.registered_mobile: The customer's registered mobile number for OTP delivery.
input_entities.contact_id: The Webex contact or interaction identifier for audit correlation.
input_entities.reason: Short reason for verification, for example Open CRM profile during support call.
input_entities.ipaddr: Optional customer IP address when available.

pending_outcome.verification_url: Secure page where the customer enters OTP outside the AI Agent transcript

verified_outcome.crm_url: URL returned only after Webex Connect verifies the OTP
